t.id, t.task_no, t.inspection_time, t.group_leader_id, t.deputy_leader_id, t.department_id, t.profession_id, t.task_description, t.status, t.notification_sent, t.create_user_id, t.create_time, t.update_time, t.deleted, gl.real_name as group_leader_name, dl.real_name as deputy_leader_name, d.dept_name as department_name, p.dict_label as profession_name, cu.real_name as create_user_name

SELECT
FROM sys_monthly_inspection_task t LEFT JOIN sys_user gl ON t.group_leader_id = gl.id AND gl.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user dl ON t.deputy_leader_id = dl.id AND dl.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON t.department_id = d.id AND d.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_dictionary p ON t.profession_id = p.dict_value AND p.dict_type = '专业' AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user cu ON t.create_user_id = cu.id AND cu.deleted = 0 WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.deleted = 0

SELECT
FROM sys_monthly_inspection_task t LEFT JOIN sys_user gl ON t.group_leader_id = gl.id AND gl.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user dl ON t.deputy_leader_id = dl.id AND dl.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON t.department_id = d.id AND d.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_dictionary p ON t.profession_id = p.dict_value AND p.dict_type = '专业' AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user cu ON t.create_user_id = cu.id AND cu.deleted = 0 WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND (t.group_leader_id = #{userId} OR t.deputy_leader_id = #{userId})
AND t.status = #{status}
ORDER BY t.create_time DESC
